title.narrative: 1st Offline advocacy meeting on expanding the role of just transition in the national planning documents (NECP, NDC etc.)

description.narrative: Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Communities and Territories Development, Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, Ministry of Energy and the Office of Green Transition under the Ministry of Economy.

Offline consultation meetings with the Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Communities and Territories Development, Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, Ministry of Energy and the Office of Green Transition under the Ministry of Economy. Topic - developing joint position.
Milestones: 1st offline coordination meeting, September 2025; 2nd offline coordination meeting, January 2026.

The activity provides achieving the next output: At least one position of Ecoaction and at least one joint position with other NGOs/coalition(s) of NGOs on the issues with the current definition and understanding of just transition are prepared and raised with the Ministry of Economy, the Ministry of Communities and Territories Development and the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, and in the Ukrainian media.

activity-date.narrative: The end of activity was following with reporting, gathering participants's feedback, purchasing all the bills after the main event.
The first offline coordinational meeting took place in September in Kyiv. The preparation started from August

sector.narrative: The meeting was conducted for Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Communities and Territories Development, Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, Ministry of Energy and the Office of Green Transition under the Ministry of Economy.

description.narrative: The amount 18000 GBP was transferred to the accont of NGO "Alternative" for the next activities. The remainder was used for the activity
